payload.title: Mon 11/9: What a grocery store tour is for
payload.purpose: Grocery Store Tours: what the dietitians look at with clients in the aisles and why it changes the week.

captions.FB: Grocery Store Tours at the Bariatric Counseling Center aren't just about finding healthier foods. Our registered dietitians walk the aisles with clients, practicing real-world skills that make the rest of the week easier. You learn how to read labels, compare options, and plan meals without feeling overwhelmed. It's one session that changes how you approach every shopping trip after. We provide group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes and movement education in San Antonio and virtual across Texas. One program, not four. Link in the first comment.
captions.IG:
Grocery store tours with registered dietitians

At the Bariatric Counseling Center, Grocery Store Tours are hands-on sessions where our registered dietitians walk the aisles with clients. You practice reading labels, comparing options, and planning meals in the moment. It's not about memorizing rules. It's about building confidence for every trip after that one. Our program includes group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes and movement education. One program, not four. San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

#BariatricCounseling #VirtualTherapyTexas #BariatricSupport #MindfulRecovery #SanAntonio
